description: Which institution is this? A name or an IPEDS UNITID answers with the institution's identity, sector, identifiers with their sources, how many programs, checklists, and learning units its published catalog holds here, and what else CourseShelf stores about it: transfer agreements and pathways, prior learning policies and rules, the exam programs it grants credit for, on-campus housing, in-state tuition, veterans services and transfer credit policies. A name is read whole, never as a fragment: case, punctuation, a leading "The", "&" for "and", "St." for "Saint" and "X at Y" for "X-Y" are set aside, and a name equal to one school's, or to an IPEDS alias reviewed to name that school, is that school. Several fits, or a read only by initials, by an alias that does not name one school, or by words of a name, are candidates and none is chosen. Every answer says how it matched (matched_by) and whether it is one school (resolved). A state lists that state's institutions by name; a school type, or a filter on what CourseShelf stores, lists across the country without a state, with the sectors of the schools listed and their counts; with none of these, the answer is the states that hold institutions, each with its count. A web address answers the institution that publishes it, so a school named by its own site is identified without an IPEDS number in hand. Each row names its current FORM's wording source: source_url, capture_file, catalog_year and source_catalog_name are that one source's, never the record's whole span. A row whose record holds more than one form or more than one source also carries version_count, source_count, first_edition_seen and last_edition_seen, and one sentence saying so in words; a record with one form and one source carries none of them and reads exactly as it always has. The forms themselves, each with its own content and its own sources, come from the one-record get, never from a list. A record last seen in an older edition says so, because the Union keeps a record no current catalog prints.

city.description: Optional city, one of a state answer's cities, e.g. Denison

domain.description: Optional: the institution's own web address, matched against the addresses it publishes, e.g. uindy.edu

exam_credit.description: Optional: only schools with a published rule granting credit for this exam program

locale.description: Optional, where the publish holds the College Scorecard's characteristics: only schools in this setting (NCES locale)

offset.description: Optional: the next_offset from a previous answer

on_campus_housing.description: Optional: only schools that publish an on-campus room and board cost (College Scorecard)

online_only.description: Optional, where the publish holds the College Scorecard's characteristics: only schools whose programs are all offered online

query.description: A school's name, its web address, or its IPEDS UNITID, e.g. University of Tennessee at Chattanooga, utc.edu or 221740; words of a name give candidates

residential.description: Optional, where the publish holds the College Scorecard's characteristics: only primarily or highly residential four-year schools (Carnegie size and setting)

sector.description: Optional school type as IPEDS labels it, e.g. public 2-year; without a state, that type's institutions across the country, those with a catalog held first

state.description: Optional two-letter state, e.g. TX: that state's institutions, those with a catalog held first; the answer lists the state's cities

tuition_in_max.description: Optional: only schools whose in-state tuition and fees (College Scorecard) is at or under this many dollars a year

with_agreements.description: Optional: only schools with at least one transfer agreement held

with_pathways.description: Optional: only schools taking part in at least one pathway held

with_prior_learning.description: Optional: only schools with a published prior learning policy or a published rule for credit for prior learning they receive

with_transfer_policy.description: Optional: only schools with a published transfer credit policy

with_veteran_services.description: Optional: only schools with veterans and military services held
